🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive (Narrow/Weak); neutral SPY/TLT, HYG/LQD and XLY/XLP signals support a mixed read, while VXX is a risk warning.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear is increasing: VXX (1W: +8.10% | 1M: +11.86%) ABOVE TREND. Credit and stocks-versus-bonds signals are flat and neutral; HYG/LQD and SPY/TLT show no confirmed directional pressure.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Rates pressure is visible in TLT (1W: -3.15% | 1M: -0.42%) BELOW TREND. Dollar and yield-curve ETF signals are not provided, so broader financial conditions remain unconfirmed.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Defensive sectors are relatively resilient: XLP (1W: +1.88% | 1M: +5.68%) and XLU (1W: +0.75% | 1M: +4.52%) ABOVE TREND; XLF (1W: +0.33% | 1M: +4.79%) ABOVE TREND. Tech is weak: XLK (1W: -3.58% | 1M: -10.20%) BELOW TREND; with breadth at 4/11 and the tech/financials signal neutral, style is mixed / no clear leadership.

5. US vs Global?
Global equities are broadly weak: EEM (1W: -3.51% | 1M: -6.30%) and FXI (1W: -3.87% | 1M: -1.54%) BELOW TREND. India is a relative exception: INDA (1W: +0.29% | 1M: +8.18%) ABOVE TREND; the EM-versus-US signal is flat and neutral.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation is weak: ARKK (1W: -9.41% | 1M: -12.37%) and IBIT (1W: -13.07% | 1M: -20.28%) BELOW TREND. Small caps are in CORRECTION: IWM (1W: -3.39% | 1M: +0.92%).

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Industrial metals and precious metals are under pressure: CPER (1W: -6.25% | 1M: -8.78%), GLD (1W: -7.01% | 1M: -7.61%) and SLV (1W: -11.94% | 1M: -17.71%) BELOW TREND. The copper/gold signal is flat and neutral.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy is mixed: XLE (1W: +2.83% | 1M: -6.67%) RECOVERY, while BNO (1W: -0.46% | 1M: -12.70%) and UNG (1W: -2.58% | 1M: -7.88%) BELOW TREND.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Core weakness is confirmed by SPY (1W: -1.69% | 1M: -3.05%), XLK (1W: -3.58% | 1M: -10.20%) and TLT (1W: -3.15% | 1M: -0.42%), all BELOW TREND. XLF (1W: +0.33% | 1M: +4.79%) ABOVE TREND is a counterpoint; this is not a major 1W/1M divergence across the core ETFs.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Stay selective and favor relative resilience in XLP (1W: +1.88% | 1M: +5.68%) and XLU (1W: +0.75% | 1M: +4.52%), both ABOVE TREND. Reduce exposure to weak growth and speculative areas, including QQQ (1W: -2.59% | 1M: -6.77%) and ARKK (1W: -9.41% | 1M: -12.37%), both BELOW TREND.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: If breadth improves beyond 4/11 and defensive leadership persists, monitor XLP (1W: +1.88% | 1M: +5.68%) ABOVE TREND.
BEARISH: If weakness broadens, watch XLK (1W: -3.58% | 1M: -10.20%) BELOW TREND for continued pressure.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: If weekly momentum turns positive, monitor CPER (1W: -6.25% | 1M: -8.78%) BELOW TREND for stabilization.
BEARISH: If energy weakness persists, watch BNO (1W: -0.46% | 1M: -12.70%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
No absolute price levels are supplied. Monitor breadth against 5/11, VXX’s weekly change from +8.10%, and the neutral direction in HYG/LQD and SPY/TLT.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, with Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive (Narrow/Weak); neutral ratio signals temper the rise in VXX.
Defensive resilience is clearest in XLP (1W: +1.88% | 1M: +5.68%) and XLU (1W: +0.75% | 1M: +4.52%), both ABOVE TREND; style leadership remains mixed.
Monitor rising fear in VXX (1W: +8.10% | 1M: +11.86%) ABOVE TREND and continued weakness in XLK (1W: -3.58% | 1M: -10.20%) BELOW TREND.
